header: From your spreadsheet to a published rota
lead: Most sites go live within two weeks. You don't need an IT department, and we don't bill the setup as a project.

steps.title: Send us last year's rotas
steps.text: Send your rotas and staff list in any form. We accept spreadsheets, PDFs and photos of a wall planner.

steps.title: We set up the rules
steps.text: Contracts, opening hours, premium rates and who may work alone. This is the only step that needs a call with us.

steps.title: Invite the team
steps.text: Staff install the app and check their own contract details. This is usually where the first three errors show up.

steps.title: Publish week one
steps.text: Run the first week alongside the old plan. From week two, nobody needs the whiteboard.
